propositions: The module-size gate must be rewritten to enforce an absolute 800 LOC cap from a single source file (.github/module-size-limit.txt) with no allowlist exemptions.
The limit must be locked so that changes cannot alter it except via admin override, enforced by comparing the limit file on main's tip against the current change's value and failing if they differ.

The gate must fetch main's tip by explicit GitHub URL (matching the existing tickets-branch fetch pattern) to enable the lock check, warn on fetch failure, and fall through to the absolute cap only on total fetch failure.
The gate must fail if the limit file is missing, absent from both workflows' references to allowlist/ceilings files, and read the limit as a positive integer.
Unit tests (test_module_size_contract.py and test_ci_workflow_parity.py) must be updated to read the limit from the single source file and assert compliance without checking allowlist/ceilings sync.
The allowlist and ceilings files must be retained (but emptied) during Phase 2a to keep main's current gate working on this change's CI; deletion deferred to Phase 2b.
